noVideoTitle: Choose a video to start repeating
noVideoDesc: Supports local videos (mp4 / webm / mov) and audio (mp3 / wav etc.). You can also drag files (together with subtitles) from Windows Explorer into the window. The waveform is analyzed automatically, a same-named subtitle loads automatically, and you can use AB repeat and loop selected subtitle segments.

drop.hint: Drop to import: the same-named subtitle loads automatically

ab.tipIdle: Click while playing to set point A; click while stopped then pick on the waveform
ab.tipB: Click again to set point B and start looping
ab.hintPickA: AB repeat: click on the waveform to set point A
ab.hintPickB: AB repeat: click on the waveform to set point B (or click this button to use the current position)
ab.gapInvalid: Point B must be after point A (at least 0.3s)

list.title: Subtitles
list.selectionEmpty: Check or drag-select subtitle segments to repeat first
list.dragHint: Click to seek · double-click to edit · checking any cue auto-plays the selection; uncheck to stop
list.emptyDesc: Click "Load Subtitles" or drop a subtitle file into the window; a same-named subtitle (srt/vtt/ass etc.) next to the video loads automatically

toast.saved: Subtitles saved to the original file
toast.subtitleLoadFailed: Failed to load subtitles, please check the file format
toast.subtitleUnsupported: This file is not an importable subtitle format
toast.videoError: Failed to load video, please choose another file
toast.waveFailed: Waveform analysis failed; showing a placeholder
toast.needVideoFirst: Load a video before importing a subtitle file

audioMode: Audio repeat mode · waveform, AB repeat and subtitles work like video

library.emptyDesc: Use "Favorite current media" in the toolbar or right-click a recent item to favorite files, then organize them into categories

playlist.emptyDesc: Create a group with "New group", then add media from the library context menu
playlist.emptyList: This group is empty. Use "Add to playlist" from the library context menu

meta.title: Media metadata
meta.nameHint: The name is used for display and sorting; the original file is untouched

mediaClickHint: Click to pause/resume, double-click for fullscreen

group.noneYet: No groups yet — create one below

fav.title: Saved
fav.noSource: Load a subtitle file first (source is recorded on save)
fav.noVideo: This saved cue has no linked video to locate
fav.locateHint: Click to locate this cue (auto-loads files)
fav.emptyDesc: Right-click a subtitle cue and choose "Save this cue"; the source file and timestamps are recorded for one-click locating
fav.filterEmpty: No saved cues in this group

edit.splitHint: Place the caret where to break; multi-line text can also be split by lines, duration split proportionally
edit.needTwo: Select at least two cues to merge
edit.needPrev: This is already the first cue
edit.needNext: This is already the last cue
edit.singleLine: This cue has a single line — use "Split at caret"
edit.splitInvalid: Place the caret at a valid split position (text on both sides)

abGapInvalid: Point B must be after point A (at least 0.3s)
